response.evidence: Build your container by running the following command in your project's root directory... docker build -t <your-astro-image-name> . To run your image as a local container, use the following command... docker run -p <local-port>:<container-port> <your-astro-image-name>
response.rationale: The Recipe section first instructs building an image tagged <your-astro-image-name> via docker build, then the immediately following step runs that same tagged image as a local container with docker run, so the image run locally is the one produced by the preceding build command.
